profile.headline: MIT Graduate from AeroAstro and EECS

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mission Autonomy
positions.description: Design and Develop core architectural services for autonomous functionality
positions.insights: Skills: Peer Reviews · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Cross-team Collaboration · C++20 · Python 3

positions.title: Visual System Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a plugin architecture (in C++) for the calibration and alignment of a real-time flight simulator system for the T7-A, F-15, and Apache programs.
VR integration with existing flight simulation software.
Implemented a code review process to continuously improve the quality of code outputted by the team

positions.title: Hardware Validation
positions.description:
Implemented Continuous Integration methods for testing Apple hardware, utilized GitLab CI/CD pipeline
Designed backend models, implemented REST automation interfaces, Frontend UI design (Full Project Ownership), automated daily/weekly testing tasks in a continual improvement fashion
Hardware characterization/limit testing, worked with various teams to administer solutions to discovered bugs
Utilized the data visualization tool Tableau to characterize the performance of hardware
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · End-to-End Project Management · Django · Test Automation Framework

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Utilized ROS on the Baxter robotic arm to identify different objects by common categories (wrenches, hammers, screwdrivers, etc)
Determined baseline evaluations of existing object detection techniques to compare adding additional classes
SuperUROP in Augmented One-Shot Learning, implemented a Hierarchical Bayesian model with a matching network to improve few shot accuracies, evaluate object hierarchy, and learn

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Researched and designed a demonstration for a new product involving homomorphic encryption techniques
Implemented SHA3 hash algorithm on already encrypted data for signature purposes
Developed a web-based attribute-based encryption application to encrypt batch DoD files (Django)

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a characterization test to qualify a passive thermal switch
Designed and constructed a motor testbed to test control algorithms, measure motor attributes, and characterize the unplanned motion of motors and their loads
Utilized ROS Gazebo to simulate a cube balloon, characterized its thrusters, implemented a PID control algorithm, and integrated an IMU, sonar, and camera (Aruco marker tracking) into the PID controller

educations.fieldOfStudy: Aerospace and Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
